source: NASA OSDR OSD-895 EDEN ISS 2018 biomass summary
sourceCaveat: OSD-895 ships only a PDF (fpls-11-00656.pdf). The CSV used here is a manual transcription of a table in that paper, not a machine-readable NASA dataset. Values are EDEN ISS terrestrial-analogue (Antarctic) greenhouse results, not ISS or lunar/Martian measurements.
normalisationPolicy: harvest_biomass_g is edible fresh biomass per m^2 per cycle. EDEN ISS values are cumulative across a phase of differing length. Direct comparison only when harvest age is within 25% of one cycle; otherwise age-normalised with a stated linear-accumulation assumption.

lettuce.source: NASA OSDR OSD-895 EDEN ISS 2018 biomass summary (PDF-derived table)
lettuce.normalisation: direct cycle comparison (harvest age within 25% of one simulator cycle)

tomato.source: NASA OSDR OSD-895 EDEN ISS 2018 biomass summary (PDF-derived table)
tomato.normalisation: values were scaled by cycleDays/harvestAgeDays assuming linear cumulative accumulation across multiple harvests. This is an ASSUMPTION, not a measured per-cycle figure, so the comparison supports plausibility only and is NOT a calibration target.
tomato.suggestionStatus: proposed, NOT applied - requires owner approval because it changes user-visible simulator output, and the supporting n is 2

radish.source: NASA OSDR OSD-895 EDEN ISS 2018 biomass summary (PDF-derived table)
radish.normalisation: direct cycle comparison (harvest age within 25% of one simulator cycle)
radish.suggestionStatus: proposed, NOT applied - requires owner approval because it changes user-visible simulator output, and the supporting n is 2
